title: Query–Document Dense Vectors for LLM Relevance Judgment Bias Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Embedding query-document pairs into a joint semantic space, clustering them with HDBSCAN to form semantic neighborhoods, and calculating Gwet's AC1 metric to measure cluster-level agreement variations between LLMs and human assessors. This identifies systematic misalignments such as definitional rigidity, over-strict filtering, and contextual ambiguity.
